evidence.summary: KMMS uses academic eligibility, SJT and a UCAT cognitive threshold as gates, then contextualises/scored applicants separately by group. The official 2026-entry UCAT threshold on the 900-2700 scale is unpublished, so official runtime prediction is unavailable. ApplySmart advisory bands use the approved historical-percentile-equivalent zone and are not official KMMS thresholds, rankings or decisions.

eligibility.scope: Automatic gates cover GCSE, achieved A-level, achieved IB, verified Access to HE Medicine, supported Scottish profile, achieved graduate degree, verified international equivalence, UCAT presence and SJT rules. Official UCAT cognitive threshold remains non-executable while null.

score_model.basis: ApplySmart advisory historical-percentile-equivalent UCAT zone only; official KMMS runtime gate remains unavailable while official_2026_threshold_2700 is null.

disabled_public_bands.reason: No separate approved upper boundary was supplied; scores at or above the approved high historical-equivalent point are labelled Strong, not Guaranteed.
KMMS publishes no guaranteed-interview UCAT rule.

score_model.disclaimer: ApplySmart Advisory Prediction - This guidance is based on historical percentile equivalence and historical KMMS admissions evidence. It is not an official KMMS interview threshold, ranking or admissions decision.
guardrails: Advisory bands cannot alter academic eligibility.
Advisory bands cannot override the official UCAT threshold.
Advisory bands cannot pass or reject an applicant.
Advisory bands cannot alter Group A-E routing.
Advisory bands cannot replace contextual academic ranking.
Advisory bands must not imply that KMMS ranks applicants by UCAT.

official_prediction.explanation: KMMS has not published an exact 2026 interview cut-off on the current UCAT scale. Shortlisting may also depend on contextual ranking or other information that ApplySmart cannot fully reproduce.
